items.title: Write the cli-engine modularization execution plan document
items.context: Document current cli-engine.ts inventory, god-file root cause, four-stage decomposition, compatibility exports, high-risk gates, Authority Server strong-verification path, local 3x2 plan verdict requirements, and 3x1 degraded fallback semantics.
items.userSees: Final response includes: "Created docs/requirements/decisions/cli-engine-modularization-execution-plan.md with the staged cli-engine split plan; B-0717 did not refactor cli-engine.ts."
excludes: No cli-engine.ts implementation changes in this story
No command rename/removal in this story

happy.desc: The execution plan document exists and has purpose, non-goals, current inventory, target boundaries, execution rounds, verification matrix, and rollback/stop conditions.

edge.desc: The document explicitly distinguishes B-0717 documentation work from future implementation stories so no source refactor is implied as done here.

adversarial.desc: The plan does not hide high-risk process facts behind prose-only claims; gate/Authority-sensitive assertions point to mechanical verification or future required receipts.

verificationEvidence.note: Document exists at the declared path and includes purpose, non-goals, current inventory, compatibility contract, four implementation rounds, Authority flow, local quorum, verification matrix, implementation split, rollback/stop conditions, and reviewer checklist.
The Purpose and Non-Goals sections explicitly state B-0717 is documentation only and does not refactor packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts or claim cli-engine decomposition is complete.

Authority-sensitive claims require authority_receipt_verify against production gate_decision receipts and lifecycle receipt consumption; local status/readiness/verdict prose is explicitly barred from production Authority completion claims.

items.title: Verify the plan against current cli-engine and command contracts
items.context: Use current source inventory and contract docs to prove the plan preserves MAIN_TOOLS, command-policy coverage, handler registry dispatchability, owner lease/read-only reviewer gates, INIT_CHECK metadata sync, and JSON stdout behavior.
items.userSees: Final response includes: "Verified the plan against current cli-engine.ts inventory, registry/handler split, exported compatibility surfaces, and available package verification commands."
excludes: Source and script touchpoints are read-only inventory/verification references in B-0717, not modification targets.
No source-code move in this story
No direct story JSON or fixture JSON edits

happy.desc: The plan includes a current inventory of cli-engine.ts responsibilities and explicitly notes that handlers are already split through registry/handlers.
The plan lists compatibility surfaces that future implementation stories must preserve or migrate, including MAIN_TOOLS, parseFlags, owner lease helpers, and init-check metadata sync exports.

edge.desc: The verification matrix uses commands that exist in the current package scripts or marks commands as conditional when no package script exists.

adversarial.desc: The plan avoids a line-count-only split and instead assigns modules by responsibility boundaries with stop conditions for process-fact regressions.

verificationEvidence.command: wc -l packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts && rg -n "MAIN_TOOLS|parseFlags|ownerLeaseHelpBlock|resolveEffectiveOwnershipClass|enforceStoryOwnerLeaseGate|commitInitCheckMetadataAndMergeMain|runCli|story_create|story_advance|recover_evidence" packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts && rg -n "from ./cli-engine|cli-engine" packages/main/src packages/main/tests scripts package.json packages/main/package.json
verificationEvidence.note: Source inventory confirms cli-engine.ts is 4450 lines, owns MAIN_TOOLS/flag helpers/owner and reviewer gates/init-check sync/runCli special dispatch, and handlers are already separated through registry/handlers consumers rather than requiring handler moves first.

Compatibility Contract section lists MAIN_TOOLS, parseFlags, parseFlagsTest, coerce, addValue, ownerLeaseHelpBlock, resolveEffectiveOwnershipClass, enforceStoryOwnerLeaseGate, reviewer read-only helpers, and commitInitCheckMetadataAndMergeMain as preserve-or-migrate symbols.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs && npm --prefix packages/main run test:command-ownership-contract && npm --prefix packages/main run test:main-write-lock-coverage && node packages/main/dist/tasks/cli-json-stdout-contract-smoke.js
verificationEvidence.note: All executable verification matrix commands completed successfully; JSON stdout smoke was run via direct dist task because no package script is declared for it.

Target Module Boundaries split by responsibility rather than line count and each round has stop conditions for command disappearance, schema drift, JSON stdout changes, owner/reviewer gate weakening, and INIT_CHECK metadata regression.

items.title: Record strong-verification readiness and review quorum requirements
items.context: Document and verify the exact commands/conditions for Authority Server receipt-backed validation if configured, plus local full 3x2 host verdict and explicit degraded 3x1 fallback boundaries for environments without Authority receipts.
items.userSees: Final response includes: "Authority Server receipt flow, local 3x2 quorum, and degraded 3x1 fallback are documented; current local Authority status is off/not-configured, so no production Authority completion is claimed."
excludes: Do not claim Authority production completion without verified gate_decision receipt
Do not treat 3x1 as equivalent to 3x2

happy.desc: The plan defines the Authority Server command flow: status/readiness, job creation, independent verdict submission, job status reconciliation, receipt verification, and lifecycle receipt consumption boundary.
The plan defines 3 rounds x 2 hosts as required local strong-review quorum for high-risk cli-engine implementation slices.

edge.desc: When authority_status is off/not-configured, the plan states that local 3x2 can proceed only as lower-assurance evidence and cannot claim production Authority DONE.

adversarial.desc: The plan states that 3 rounds x 1 host is a degraded fallback requiring explicit fallback classification, not a normal pass path for major architecture work.

verificationEvidence.command: node bin/lattice.js authority_status --json; node bin/lattice.js authority_job_create --help; node bin/lattice.js authority_verdict_submit --help; node bin/lattice.js authority_job_status --help; node bin/lattice.js authority_receipt_verify --help
verificationEvidence.note: Authority command flow is mechanically available and documented: status/readiness, job creation, verdict submit, job status reconciliation, receipt verify, and lifecycle consumption boundary via verified production gate_decision receipt refs.

Local 3x2 evidence was recorded: 6 pass verdicts across host A and host B, 2 independent passing hosts, staleVerdicts=0, multiHostVerified=true; every verdict note says local/offline and not a production Authority gate_decision receipt.

Current local Authority state is status=not-configured, authorityReady=false, receiptVerified=false, productionDone=false, canClaimProductionDone=false, so B-0717 cannot claim production Authority completion.

Local Quorum Flow section defines 3 rounds x 2 independent hosts as default high-risk local review and 3 rounds x 1 host as degraded lower-assurance fallback only, never equivalent to 3x2 for major architecture work.
